title: Matrix Dressing Beyond Pfaff-Toda
summary: We develop a matrix pseudodifference operator framework that places theAdler-Pfaff and Pfaff-Toda hierarchies in a common algebraic setting. The bi-infinite Adler-Pfaff hierarchy then becomes a $2\times2$ matrix pseudodifference Lax hierarchy. We introduce the Matrix Pfaff-Toda hierarchy by dressing the matrix Laurent algebra $M_{2N}\bigl(\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{S},\mathcal{S}^{-1}]\bigr)$ using a Pfaff-Toda splitting of the matrix pseudodifference algebra.
